tools.name: calc_claim
tools.description: Calculate statutory late-payment interest (per half-year period), the fixed compensation for recovery costs and the total for an unpaid EU B2B invoice. Each number comes with its legal reference.

tools.name: draft_reminder
tools.description: Draft reminder letter 1 (friendly, day 3), 2 (firm with interest, compensation and calculation sheet, day 10) or 3 (final notice, day 17) in en/de/fr/es/it/nl/pl/et. Returns subject, text, printable HTML and a mailto link. The creditor sends it from their own mailbox; PagoFix sends nothing.

tools.name: draft_eop
tools.description: Prepare a DRAFT European order for payment (Form A, Reg. 1896/2006) for a cross-border claim, with court note, fee info and filing guidance. The creditor signs and files it themselves. (x402 payment requirement is configured as a stub only.)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Where a case stands today: days overdue, which reminder is due now, next step and date, current total. Pass the case fields or a caseId returned earlier.
